content:
Do not pause engineering work.

Continue autonomous execution for safe code repairs.

You are authorized to:

- fix code defects
- fix CI failures
- fix Gradle/Expo version mismatches
- repair tests
- repair workflows
- improve architecture
- clean duplicate and dead code
- improve stability
- open branches
- create commits
- open pull requests
- rerun CI

Do NOT deploy production automatically.
Do NOT modify production secrets.
Do NOT modify production databases.
Do NOT change authentication or payments without approval.

Continue until every safe engineering task is complete.

Only stop if an explicit owner approval is required.
